Open review questions

  • Shell/body separation is unresolved. Check whether the peach shell stays distinguishable from the paw and green apron at 32–36px, especially during the low-shell crouch. Shell, hands and body are baked together in each pose; this file provides no separate shell layer or independent motion.
  • The crouch is 8.96% shorter than idle. It is an intermediate pose here; final settlement reuses the unchanged idle. No per-pose height normalization or synthetic in-between frames are applied.
  • Measured sole midpoints are held at one canvas anchor. Foot spread and anatomical proportions still vary by pose; fixed anchoring alone does not prove smooth motion.
  • Most interior pixels use alpha253, approximately0.78% transparency. Another14,322 pixels have alpha1–7. Their visual impact, haloing and safe frame boundaries remain review questions.
  • Rendered frame windows use the measured alpha≥8 bounds with4px padding. Faint outlying pixels beyond those windows are not shown in the animation. This is runtime clipping, not raster cleanup; the full raw strip remains embedded below.

Source and measured geometry

Coordinates are source pixels. Bounds are left/top inclusive, right/bottom exclusive. Pivots are proposed render anchors measured from the two sole runs; they are not verified physical animation anchors. No regular atlas grid is assumed.
